title: Fluxo
subtitle: Brand & Social Campaign
overview: This project involved the creation of a cohesive brand and social media campaign for Fluxo, a dispatch management platform built to run order management, rider management, and daily dispatch operations from one place. The goal was to communicate Fluxo's core promise — simpler, faster dispatch — to dispatch company owners through a consistent, high-impact visual system.
problem: Dispatch companies are often run across scattered tools, spreadsheets, and chat threads, making order tracking, rider coordination, and daily operations fragmented and time-consuming for the people running them.
solution: A bold, consistent visual campaign built around Fluxo's "one place" concept. Clean layouts and a confident typographic system frame the platform's key benefits — order management, rider management, and time saved — while targeted messaging speaks directly to business owners and growing dispatch companies. The campaign closes with a clear waitlist call to action.
